rigveda_mandala3_hymn51.title: Rigveda Mandala 3 Hymn 51
rigveda_mandala3_hymn51.description: This hymn belongs to Mandala 3 of the Rigveda. Rigvedic hymns are ancient Vedic verses revealed to sages (Rishis) and dedicated to cosmic principles and deities such as Agni, Indra, Varuna, Surya, Soma and others.

rigveda_mandala3_hymn51.scripture_text: A representative Rigvedic mantra passage for Mandala 3, Hymn 51, celebrating divine light, sacred order, and contemplative insight.
rigveda_mandala3_hymn51.philosophical_explanation: Rigvedic hymns often express reverence for natural forces and cosmic order (Rta). They reflect early Vedic philosophy exploring the relationship between humans, nature and the divine. Many hymns emphasize harmony, sacrifice (yajna), spiritual insight, and the search for truth.
